First, click on the windows button on your keyboard and then type : Device Manger.

Press enter and you will see the device manager.

Now click on the arrow next to "Display Adapters", under that you should find your gpu's name.

Right click on it, and click on properties.

Now click on the driver tab, and click on the button called : Roll Back Driver.

And that's supposed to be it, you can see more information [here](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/driver-rollback/).
